_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% 12h move rate over 7 days and 0/14 directional track record confirm this is a tight coil with no breaker visible, making HOLD the statistically and structurally correct call.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD explicitly while narrative writer frames a bullish coiled divergence; the split is on forward direction, not current phase.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding drops below 0.005% with exchange_netflow falling below 80 and btc_momentum_30d holding above 50, signaling accumulation replacing distribution.
next_move.invalidated_if: Exchange_netflow stays above 95 with btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d climbing past 98 and funding rising above 0.012%, confirming distribution is accelerating into any relief rally.
